moat_against: MS patent cliff: Tecfidera generics globally, Tysabri biosimilars in EU and entering US
Leqembi slow uptake, ARIA safety burden, Lilly competition
Spinraza competition from Zolgensma and Evrysdi
Binary pipeline risk; growth depends on registrational readouts and M&A (Apellis, RayThera)
Payer/pricing pressure on high-cost neurology drugs
moat_for: Orphan/rare-disease franchises (Spinraza, Skyclarys, Qalsody) with regulatory exclusivity
Leqembi first-mover Alzheimer's position with Eisai, strengthened by at-home Iqlik formulation
Neuroscience R&D, manufacturing and specialist commercial infrastructure
moat_justification: Historical moat was patent-protected MS blockbusters and has already been breached (Tecfidera generics globally, Tysabri biosimilars in Europe with US entry following). What remains is narrower: orphan-drug exclusivity in rare diseases, a first-mover Alzheimer's position shared with Eisai, and an anti-CD20 royalty stream Biogen does not control — against binary pipeline risk, Leqembi's slow uptake and ARIA burden, Spinraza competition, and payer pressure. CAP = 7.2 years.
name: Biogen Inc.
one_liner: Transitioning biotech, moat 4/10 — real growth portfolio but a shrinking legacy base; at $228.91 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 8.70%, IV@15% $113.39 vs $228.91); clears 15% only at or below $113.39.
